jobs.description:

**Compensation**
----------------

We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.

  

1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

As Headway’s SF Office Manager, and early member of the Workplace Experience Team, you’ll play a central and autonomous role in shaping the workplace experience for Headway employees. We’re looking for a gritty, operationally excellent, and relationship-obsessed team player to support Headway’s human hypergrowth and progress towards our mission. This is an exceptional opportunity for someone who thrives making independent, consequential decisions at the intersection of facilities operations & community in a dynamic, high-growth, and mission-driven environment.

**You will**
------------

* Own and independently manage SF office operations — exercise judgment on vendor selection, facility priorities, and resource allocation; serve as Headway’s authorized point of contact with building management, local vendors, and external partners
* Own the SF office budget — make spend decisions within approved parameters, identify and resolve budget variances, and proactively recommend operational efficiencies to leadership
* Exercise independent judgment in evaluating, onboarding, and holding vendors accountable to performance standards — negotiate day-to-day contract terms and escalate material issues with a recommended resolution
* Drive space utilization strategy — analyze usage patterns, determine layout and policy adjustments, and implement changes that optimize the SF workplace environment
* Design and own office communications and engagement — build the tools, channels, and rituals that keep SF employees informed and connected, exercising judgment on format, frequency, and content
* Lead planning and execution of in-person events and onsites — scope, resource, and deliver ~50 onsites/year in SF, including team gatherings, office-wide programming, and community moments
* Own SF office knowledge resources and playbooks — determine what gets built, maintained, and retired across Confluence pages, FAQs, and office guides
* Support office buildout and special projects — independently manage furniture upgrades, hackathon logistics, and ad hoc initiatives from scoping through completion
* In support of the above, you’ll also handle day-to-day operational needs including visitor registration, supply restocking, A/V setup, and reception

**You’d be a great fit if…**
----------------------------

* You have a minimum of 2 years of experience working in Community, Facilities, or Workplace Experience
* You are extremely skillful and passionate about Employee Experience and Facilities
* You have excellent communication and project management skills; you’re able to keep multiple workstreams running smoothly and visibly
* You love to build new things optimizing for scale, efficiency, and engagement
* You’re comfortable making independent decisions with limited oversight — whether that’s resolving a vendor dispute, reconfiguring the floor plan, or standing up a new office program from scratch

**Comprehensive benefits:**
---------------------------

Medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, 401(k) including match for 2027!, Carrot Fertility reimbursement, and paid parental, medical and caregiver leave.

jobs.title: Assistant Account Manager, Sephora
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

Tatcha is a skincare brand rooted in timeless Japanese wisdom, offering transformative yet kind-to-skin formulas that marry Japanese botanicals with clinical ingredients. Our formulation philosophy is informed by the Japanese concept hinou dokon, which means "skin-mind same root"—an acknowledgement of the powerful connection between the skin and the brain. Guided by the mission to care for people through their skin, Tatcha takes a holistic approach to skincare from concept to formulation to clinical evaluation, offering skincare rituals that benefit both skin and mind, while emphasizing the importance of mindfulness to skin health.

**Job Summary**  
The Assistant Account Manager will support the Senior Account Manager and Senior Director in the execution of retail sales strategies, manage key account relationships, and ensure flawless execution of product launches, promotional activities, and merchandising initiatives. This role is responsible for operational support and cross-functional coordination to drive business objectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Retail Strategy & Execution:

* Assist the team in developing and executing retail strategies that align with brand goals instore & online.
* Support the planning and implementation of promotional programs, product launches, and retail activations instore & online, including sku setup process.
* Manage the coordination of new product launches, working closely with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Education, etc) to ensure timely execution and robust 360 plans.
* Partner with internal and external teams to ensure alignment on sales and promotional initiatives including sampling and points opportunities.
* Serve as a key point of contact for internal teams, ensuring that account-specific needs are met across the business.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date brand plans and communicate changes to necessary cross functional partners.
* Bring new ideas to the table

Retail Partner Support:

* Maintain day-to-day communication with key retail partners, supporting the team in fostering strong relationships.
* Support the creation of retailer presentations and marketing materials.
* Work with retail partners to ensure proper execution of promotional calendars, merchandising strategies, and inventory management instore & online.
* Coordinate with retail teams on product visibility and digital strategy to optimize both in-store and online sales channels.
* Support P&L management by owning billing and invoicing processes.
* Own internal creative process and timelines including PDPs and other marketing materials.
* Track and evaluate retailer promotional and sampling activities, providing feedback and recommendations for improvement.
* Gather market data, competitor insights, and industry trends to identify growth opportunities and areas for improvement to ensure that the brand remains competitive in the beauty marketplace.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
* 2-3 years of experience in retail account management, preferably in the beauty or skincare industry. Experience working with Sephora highly preferred.
* Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with a focus on collaboration.
* Experience in financial analysis, sales forecasting, and budget management.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and retail analytics tools.

**The Details**

The expected base salary range for this position is $70,000 to $80,000. The exact base pay is determined by various factors including experience, skills, education, geographic location, and budget.

This position is also eligible for participation in the company discretionary bonus plan based on personal performance and company results. Tatcha offers a competitive benefits package to eligible employees, including medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, accident insurance, critical illness insurance, disability insurance, retirement savings plans and company match, paid family leave, education-related programs, paid time off, and paid holidays. #LI-BH1

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disability.

jobs.title: Customer Success Generalist
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Endex builds AI agents that handle complex, end-to-end work for the world's most demanding teams. Today we're deployed across leading financial institutions and Fortune 500 companies, embedded in the tools and workflows they rely on. We operate at the frontier of agentic knowledge work, partnering closely with top AI research labs and backed by the OpenAI Startup Fund. We're on a mission to build the most capable digital coworker in the world.

**About the Role**

**Location:** New York City (Primary), Denver, Chicago, Singapore (APAC), London, San Francisco, Austin, Los Angeles  
**Commitment:** 5 Days In-Person

We're looking for someone who enjoys helping customers make progress and is willing to do the practical work between a question and a useful result.

As a Customer Success Generalist at Endex, you'll support onboarding, customer communications and adoption programs across the customer team. You'll take on changing needs as they surface, keep smaller projects moving and help the team turn recurring customer requests into a clearer operating process.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* **Support New Customers:** Prepare onboarding materials, coordinate sessions and follow up on open tasks with the account owner.
* **Investigate the First Blocker:** Gather useful context about a customer question, distinguish training from a product issue and route it with a clear next step.
* **Run Customer-Team Projects:** Coordinate onboarding preparation, targeted adoption outreach and follow-up from workshops or feature launches.
* **Maintain Customer Context:** Keep account notes, open issues and commitments accurate and accessible to the team.
* **Improve the Process:** Identify recurring requests and create practical documentation or workflows that reduce friction.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Customer Mindset:** You take a user's problem seriously and care about whether the answer helps.
* **Clear Writing:** You communicate accurately and can make an unfamiliar workflow easier to understand.
* **Practical Curiosity:** You learn tools quickly and investigate before escalating a question.
* **Strong Organization:** You keep track of details across accounts, requests and projects.
* **Flexible Follow-Through:** You can work across onboarding, support coordination and adoption programs while keeping account owners informed and commitments visible.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in customer success, support, consulting or implementation
* Comfort with Microsoft Office and enterprise productivity tools
* Experience documenting processes or running customer programs

**Full-Time Benefits**

* Health & Dental Insurance
* Monthly Wellness Stipend
* 401K Matching

jobs.title: Sr Strategic Operations Manager, Consumer
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
The Discovery team sits at the intersection of product analytics and operations within Uber Eats, owning one of the highest-leverage surfaces on the platform, how millions of eaters discover restaurants, grocery, and retail stores every day. This is not a traditional operations role. You will spend the majority of your time deep in data, writing complex SQL, building analytical frameworks, and running experiments that directly shape search ranking and cross-LOB placement across Uber Eats.  
  
You will be the analytical backbone for Search, partnering hands-on with Product, Data Science, S&P, Marketing, CRM, and peer Ops teams to translate massive datasets into actionable insights that influence ranking algorithms, drive experimentation roadmaps, and optimize how traffic is allocated across restaurants, grocery, and retail. If you thrive on navigating ambiguity with data rather than playbooks, and want to see your analysis directly move product decisions at scale, this is the role.  
  
**What You'll Do**  

* Own search analytics end-to-end: Write complex SQL queries against large-scale datasets to analyze search ranking performance, cross-LOB store and item placement, and conversion patterns across categories
* Build analytical products: Create and maintain dashboards, automated reporting, and monitoring tools that give Product, Ops, and Leadership real-time visibility into search health, ranking quality, and surface-level KPIs (conversion, GMV, engagement)
* Translate data into product influence: Synthesize operational and behavioral insights into clear recommendations that shape the search product roadmap, identifying ranking biases, surfacing gaps in cross-LOB allocation, and quantifying the impact of proposed changes
* Collaborate cross-functionally: Work across Product, Data Science, S&P, Marketing, CRM, and regional Ops teams to ensure search strategy is grounded in data and aligned across stakeholders. Serve as the connective tissue between operational reality and product development
* Manage programs and projects: Independently drive multiple workstreams from competitive search intelligence to new surface launches tracking details, managing timelines, and delivering in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift
* Scale shared surface governance: Contribute to Share of Voice frameworks and traffic allocation governance across Restaurants, Grocery, and Retail on shared discovery surfaces

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics) or equivalent practical experience
* 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, data analysis, or analytically-heavy operations roles
* Advanced SQL proficiency, write complex, production-quality queries against large-scale data warehouses (Hive/Presto or equivalent)
* Hands-on experience with Python or R for data manipulation, analysis, and automation
* Experience building dashboards and automated reporting that serve cross-functional stakeholders
* Demonstrated track record of using data to influence product or business decisions in a cross-functional environment

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* 5+ years of professional work experience in a related field, such as consulting, investment banking, strategy, operations, or analytics
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets or SQL proficiency
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
* Experience problem-solving and proposing unique solutions to complex issues
* Strong experience building and executing complex processes
* Strong communication and presentation skills, including experience presenting data & insights to a sophisticated audience
* Experience with quantitative data analysis to provide deep measurable insights
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills - building deep, trust-based relationships with teams and cross-functional partners
* Strong business judgment and critical thinking skills with the ability to use data to develop strategies and make decisions quickly

  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $131,000 per year - USD $145,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $131,000 per year - USD $145,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

San Francisco

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**
-----------------

Hybrid

**Department**
--------------

G&AOperations & People

Overview

**About Liquid AI**

Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we build general-purpose AI systems that run efficiently across every kind of hardware, from data center accelerators to on-device chips, ensuring low latency, minimal memory usage, privacy, and reliability. We partner with enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. We are scaling rapidly and need exceptional people to help us get there.

**The Opportunity**

Our People team shapes how Liquid AI grows and how we look after our people, across the US and around the world.

We’re hiring a People Operations Manager to own our HR data and the operations that run on it, so every moment in someone’s time at Liquid AI is handled properly: their offer, their first day, a move to a new country, a visa, a pay review, their last day.

Behind every record is a person. Getting the details right is one of the most direct ways we look after our team, and you’ll make sure they’re right without needing to be chased.

You’ll report to our Head of People Operations and work closely with the engineers on our People team, testing and shaping the internal operating system they’re building. This is a hands-on operator role, not an HR business partner role.

This role will be based in our SF office, typically 4 days a week.

**What We’re Looking For**

We need someone who is:

* **Detail-oriented:** You notice when something doesn’t match, see how one change affects everything downstream, and fix it.
* **A team player:** You pitch in wherever the team needs you, and no task is too small.
* **Self-directed:** You get things done without much supervision, and you know when to escalate.
* **Someone who ships:** You work at pace, get through a high volume of work, and don’t let quality slip while you do it.
* **Someone who cares about people:** You see this work as part of how we look after our team, and you handle sensitive information with care.

**The Work**

* **Own our HR data:** keep HR, payroll and headcount records accurate and matching across systems, run regular checks, fix errors fast, and flag where they’re coming from
* **Handle onboarding and offboarding admin:** take care of the paperwork and system setup for every new starter and leaver, so their records are complete and correct from day one to their last
* **Manage employee changes:** process contractor conversions, moves between states or countries, contract amendments, salary changes, leaves and visa updates, so each one is touched once and done right in every system; for visas, work with our outside immigration counsel on documents and deadlines
* **Run benefits operations:** lead open enrollment, keep plan documents current and on hand, and work with our broker on renewals and compliance
* **Manage our people vendors:** be the day-to-day admin and escalation point for our HRIS, payroll, benefits and global EOR providers, and push open issues until they’re closed
* **Run comp analysis and offer letters:** benchmark roles against market data, model the full cost of offers and changes across countries, and prepare accurate offer letters consistent with approved terms
* **Help run cross-functional projects:** work with teams across the company on People projects, including our coworking weeks, which bring the team together several times a year
* **Test and shape our internal operating system:** be our main beta tester, running new features against real cases and working with the engineers until it’s right

**Experience & Capabilities**

What you’ll need:

* Experience in People Operations, HR operations or payroll, including time at an early-stage startup or on a small team where you covered a bit of everything
* Hands-on admin experience with a modern HRIS (Rippling, Workday, Deel or similar), owning the data and processing onboarding, offboarding and employee changes in it
* Experience with employees across multiple US states and countries
* Working knowledge of US benefits and compliance (open enrollment, ERISA, COBRA)
* Strong spreadsheet and analysis skills: comp benchmarks, cost models, headcount reporting, and the habit of checking your own numbers

Helpful, not required:

* A background in finance, accounting or payroll
* Experience with US immigration processes (H-1B, O-1, green cards) alongside outside counsel
* Experience with comp benchmarking tools such as Pave or Carta

**What Success Looks Like (Year One)**

* HR, payroll and headcount records match across every system, with regular checks that catch errors before anyone else does
* Every employee change, benefits cycle and vendor issue is closed and tracked in one place
* Our internal operating system has a tight feedback loop with the operations work you do every day

**What We Offer**

* **Compensation & Equity:** Competitive base salary plus equity, so you share in what we build. Final offers reflect skills, experience, and location.
* **Time Off:** Unlimited PTO, plus company-wide Refill Days, long weekends when the whole company rests together.
* **Health & Wellbeing:** Comprehensive health coverage, with details varying by location.
* **Paid Leave:** Paid leave for pregnancy, parenting, medical needs, and caring for family.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Business Marketing Group connects businesses with their customers on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger to help them grow their businesses through solutions like pages, advertising, messaging, and more. We succeed when we help our customers grow their business leveraging our solutions. The Global Marketing Operations team runs campaign execution for business marketing, launching hundreds of campaigns a year across an expanding set of digital marketing channels.We are seeking a Marketing Operations Manager who executes campaigns AI-first, pairing deep expertise in marketing execution platforms with the AI skills to automate that work. This role is about owning operational quality by setting executional standards that can be built at agent scale. The ideal candidate is a digital marketing expert who has already replaced meaningful parts of their own workflow with AI and can show what it produced.  
  
  

### **Marketing Operations Manager Responsibilities:**

* Own campaign execution and execution quality for an assigned business area, from brief through launch, across lifecycle, email, in-product messaging, web, and Meta ads
* Use AI as the primary tool for execution work, including build specification, copy and asset variants, audience logic, and QA
* Build, configure, and test AI agents that execute campaign workflows, and own the automation roadmap for the area, reporting results in turnaround time, cost, and error rate
* Pilot new delivery capabilities, then codify what correct execution looks like and the eval rubrics that hold agents to it
* Advise partners at the brief stage on what is executable and at what cost, and translate execution learnings into platform requirements
* Raise the AI capability of the team through documentation, enablement, and coaching
* Find new ways to continually streamline execution processes, including working with XFNs (if needed) to automate handoff

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign management, or marketing automation
* Hands-on build experience in at least two digital marketing channels among email, paid social, in-product messaging, web, and SEM or display, with expert-level depth in at least one execution or ads platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, HubSpot, Adobe)
* Demonstrated use of AI to produce real marketing work output, with specific examples of what was automated and the measured effect on time, cost, quality, or volume
* Hands-on experience building, configuring, and evaluating AI agents or LLM-based workflows, including prompt iteration and judgment on where output requires human review
* Experience owning campaign execution at portfolio scale, including QA and trade-off decisions across competing requests
* Experience scaling impact beyond own execution, through standards others adopted, requirements platform teams built, and enablement that raised team capability
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience in digital marketing

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience supporting B2B marketing efforts or high-volume audience segments at global scale
* Experience leading the transition of a workflow from manual execution to automated or agentic execution
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience connecting AI tools to marketing systems through APIs, integrations, or agent tooling
* SQL fluency or comparable data skills, sufficient to validate audiences and interrogate campaign performance independently
* Comfort working in ambiguity, where the standard does not exist yet and part of the job is writing it
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.

As the Program Manager, you will lead the strategic evolution, operational excellence, and continuous improvement of front-of-house hospitality and physical logistics across the campus. In this role, you will bridge the gap between client leadership, vendor partners, and cross-functional teams to turn traditional reception desks and mailrooms into frictionless, user-centric, high-touch service hubs.

You bring a blend of hospitality mindset, analytical rigor, and process engineering to build scalable programs, set operational benchmarks, and deliver a welcoming first impression for every client and guest.

* **Program Ownership:** Define and execute the long-term vision, roadmap, and strategic goals for the Reception and Mail programs.
* **User Journey & Experience Design:** Map and continuously optimize the end-to-end guest and employee journey. Identify touchpoints to remove friction, enhance hospitality, and maintain a seamless experience.
* **Standard Operating Procedures:** Proactively develop, implement, and maintain unified SOPs for both the Reception (visitor management, security log audits, incident response) and Mail Room (routing, bulk mail processing, package room workflows) programs.
* **Process Improvement:** Shape and deploy a process-management mentality focused on driving efficiencies, cost-conscious resource optimization, and leveraging JLL best practices.
* **Training & Hospitality Standards:** Design, own, and manage the onboarding, hospitality service standards, and continuous development protocols for site teams executing Mail and Reception duties to ensure high-quality, hospitality-driven service delivery.
* **Quality Control & Compliance:** Verify the accuracy of visitor tracking, security badge protocols, and chain-of-custody mail logs. Conduct regular inspections and audits to ensure compliance with health, safety, and site security requirements.
* **Cross-Functional Integration:** Partner with the Facilities team to align workplace services with broader site goals.

* **Client Engagement:** Proactively manage relationships with the Client’s Program SMEs and senior executives, translating their business objectives into actionable program strategies.

* **Analytical Skills:** Strong ability to extrapolate and visualize data to identify potential operational gaps and proactively formulate contingency plans.

jobs.title: After Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**SYNAPSE SCHOOL POSITION OVERVIEW: After Care Coordinator**

The Synapse School in Menlo Park, CA, an innovative TK-8 independent school located in the heart of Silicon Valley, dedicated to rethinking and reimagining education, seeks an **AFTERCARE COORDINATOR** for an immediate opening.

Synapse educates a community of Change Makers by combining Social-Emotional Learning (SEL), leading-edge academics, and the practice of innovation. We have an unwavering belief in the capacity of children, and our teachers work alongside our students to unlock their powers of curiosity, discovery, and creativity. Synapse’s program provides a deep and unique range of integrated academic, social, and creative experiences to help children use their hearts and hands to unleash their passion for learning. Synapse draws students from around the San Francisco Bay Area.

Synapse is a place for people who like being in schools, who bring energy, perspective, and a sense that what we do for our students, families and colleagues matters. People who are optimistic about young people and about the world, who collaborate and communicate generously, and who approach challenges with creativity rather than cynicism, thrive at Synapse.

As a lab school, we are actively integrating AI and emerging technologies into teaching, learning, and operating. Strong candidates will be open to using AI as a tool for planning, feedback, differentiation, and innovation. Comfort with experimentation and continuous learning is essential; perfection is not.

Equally important, we’re looking for educators who model strong emotional intelligence and embody our Change Maker Outcomes: communication, perspective, risk-taking, follow through, creativity, advocacy, inquiry, feedback, and iteration. These habits of mind shape our culture and learning environment, and teachers play a central role in making them visible, practiced, and lived each day.

**POSITION DESCRIPTION**

Synapse’s After Care program and After Care School Programs give students a safe, engaging, and joyful place to learn and play after the academic day ends. Families depend on these programs being reliable and well run, and this role treats that dependability as the core of the job.

Synapse School has a full time opening for an After Care Coordinator for the 2026-27 school year. The After Care Coordinator will help manage Synapse’s After School Program vendors as well as Synapse’s internal After Care program, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and well cared for after the academic day ends. The role works closely with external vendors, Synapse faculty and staff who host programs, families, and the Business Manager.

We are looking for someone who loves kids, is highly reliable and safety-minded, is comfortable managing a wide age range from TK through 8th grade at the same time, is warm and engaging at the end of a long school day, and wants to be part of an exciting team of forward-thinking educators.

**RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING**

*Synapse After Care Operations*

● Design and lead the Synapse After Care program each afternoon alongside a team of After Care staff ● Staff, schedule, supervise, mentor, and support After Care personnel

● Plan and lead engaging activities appropriate to a wide age range, TK through 8th Grade ● Ensure the After Care space and materials are safe, organized, and well maintained

*After School Vendor Programs*

● Coordinate and schedule Vendor After School Programs

● Collect and organize required documents from vendors and instructors (insurance, background checks, etc.)

● Foster strong relationships with external vendors and internal Synapse staff hosting After School Programs ● Observe After School Program sessions and offer constructive feedback and support to instructors

*Safety, Records & Family Communication*

● Ensure the safety and joy of all students in After Care and After School Programs

● Maintain strict safety and sign-out protocols, including verifying authorized pickup ● Keep accurate daily attendance and sign-out records for all programs

● Communicate promptly and clearly with families about program logistics and any incidents ● Coordinate with classroom teachers on student needs relevant to after-school time ● Collaborate with the Business Manager on billing and payment for all After School programs

**AN IDEAL CANDIDATE WOULD POSSESS THE FOLLOWING QUALIFICATIONS**

● Experience working with a wide range of student age groups, and comfort managing TK through 8th at the same time

● Experience supervising staff or managing a program

● Undergraduate degree required

● Experience in an independent school preferred, but not required

● Highly reliable; families depend on these programs running the same way, every day ● Safety-minded, with strict attention to sign-out and pickup protocols

● Effective group management strategies

● Warm, positive, and engaging with students at the end of a long school day

● Patient and calming presence

● Proactive communicator and collaborator with excellent verbal and written communication skills ● Organized and able to prioritize efficiently, with comfort using a variety of online organizational tools ● Flexible and adaptable with creative problem solving

● Fluent in and able to model Synapse’s Nine Change Maker Outcomes and the Six Seconds emotional intelligence model (Know Yourself, Choose Yourself, Give Yourself) in daily work

● A passion to work cooperatively with colleagues on a consistent basis and actively cultivate an inclusive environment and support a school community grounded in empathy, social responsibility, and an appreciation and respect for individual differences

**SALARY RANGE AND BENEFITS**

$78,000 -$95,000

Synapse offers a generous benefits package including health, dental, and retirement, as well as additional lifestyle perks. Housing stipends available to those who qualify.

Applicants should email a cover letter of interest

jobs.title: Strategic Materials Program Manager
jobs.description:
### **About Mainspring**

Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

* Pragmatic Optimism
* Excellence without Ego
* Proactive Collaboration

### **Job Overview**

The Strategic Materials Program Manager will be the operational linchpin for our most critical, high-value components. These components feature complex supply chains, custom manufacturing processes, and high field-rework value. To orchestrate material availability across diverse demand streams, you will leverage MRP systems and AI-driven forecasting tools to review historical trends, compare scenarios, and lead rigorous capacity planning. This role owns cross-functional communication, publishes regular planning reports for leadership, and partners directly with Procurement to ensure alignment. It is an opportunity to drive high-impact supply chain visibility from raw material mill runs to final asset delivery.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end material flow and inventory visibility for critical components
* Coordinate and reconcile material requirements and allocations across multiple operational teams including Production, Project Delivery, O&M, and R&D
* Lead capacity planning and line of balance reviews with internal manufacturing teams and external stakeholders to identify and resolve throughput constraints
* Review consumption trends, build comparisons, and evaluate forecasts using MRP systems and AI-driven forecasting tools to publish comprehensive planning reports
* Partner closely with Procurement to review inventory coverage, align purchase order (PO) schedules with operational demand horizons, and prevent supply gaps
* Own cross-functional communication by gathering operational inputs and delivering transparent executive reporting on material health and schedule risks to leadership

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Deep knowledge of material requirements planning (MRP) and production scheduling logic
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets and demand signals
* Proficiency in managing ERP planning modules and optimizing system parameters
* Exceptional communication skills to bridge gaps between Engineering, Production, and Procurement

### **Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in materials management or supply chain planning in a manufacturing environment
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or a related technical field
* Advanced technical proficiency with MRP and ERP systems
* Proven track record of leading capacity planning, line of balance reviews, and cross-functional operations alignment with external suppliers
* Direct experience managing high-value, long-lead, custom-manufactured components or complex component lifecycles
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to present complex data insights clearly to cross-functional teams and executive leadership

**PROGRAM MANAGER (SUD/MH)**

**BEHAVIORAL HEALTH SERVICES**

*Full-time, Exempt*

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Position Title:** Program Manager, Behavioral Health Services

**Reports To:** Executive Director

Centered on early intervention, low-barrier access, and mild to moderate needs, services are provided in English and Spanish onsite, in the schools and in collaboration with community partners. Our services provide interventions, goal planning, skill building and education for clients to develop a sustainable approach to recovery and healing.

**Position Description:** The Program Manager will be responsible for managing the substance use early intervention program and low-barrier mental health services. The Outreach Counselor/Case Manager assists in identifying needed services and ensuring that these services are provided for and/or referrals are facilitated. The Outreach Counselor/Case Manager provides day-to-day case management activities of the identified individuals experiencing homelessness or at risk of homelessness, addressing linkages to other necessary systems of care (e.g., housing, SUD services, primary medical care, Mental health services, educational and vocational needs).

jobs.description:
**We’re delighted you’re considering joining us!**

At Hill Physicians Medical Group, we’re shaping the healthcare of the future: actively managed care that prevents disease, supports those with chronic conditions and anticipates the needs of our members.

**Join Our Team!**

Hill Physicians has much to offer prospective employees. We’re regularly recognized as one of the “Best Places to Work in the Bay Area” and have been recognized as one of the “Healthiest Places to Work in the Bay Area.” When you join our team, you’re making a great choice for your professional career and your personal satisfaction.

**DE&I Statement:**

At PriMed, your uniqueness is valued, celebrated, encouraged, supported, and embraced. Whatever your relationship with Hill Physicians, we welcome ALL that you are.

We value and respect your race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, religion, disabilities, experiences, perspectives, and other attributes. Our celebration of diversity and foundation of inclusion allows us to leverage our differences and capitalize on our similarities to better serve our communities. We do it because it's right!

**Job Description:**

Responsible for carrying out case management activities for PPO members identified through data or by Health Plan and referred to HPMG. Case management is a collaborative process that assesses, plans, implements, coordinates, monitors, and evaluates options and services required to meet the client’s health and human service needs. It is characterized by advocacy, communication and resource management and promotes quality and cost-effective interventions and outcomes. Case management activities are based on nationally recognized case management standards and concepts and principles. All contacts are telephonic.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with Health Plans care and disease management programs to maximize the at-risk population member’s quality and manage their costs.
* Assess members’ physical and psychosocial needs/barriers and develop a care plan.
* Support and encourage the use of participating Health Plan providers.
* Develop and implement the interventions needed to resolve barriers and coordinate care, allowing members to accomplish their goals with physician guidance and supervision.
* Document in Epic; assessments, care plans, interventions, and all other activity related to coordinating the care of case-managed members.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Maintain client privacy, safety, confidentiality, and advocacy while adhering to ethical, legal, regulatory and accreditation standards.
* Maintain department procedure/policy standards with regard to turnaround time, etc.
* Support the interdisciplinary team approach to ensure effective resource utilization, as well as quality and cost-effective outcomes.
* Coordinate internal and external resources for the individual member.
* Maintain and update a community resource database.
* Document all case management activities in the HPMG case management online system.
* Issue letters of explanation in accordance with department policy.
* Attend and participate in in-service programs and conferences that support practice of case management.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Required Experience**

* Minimum three years clinical nursing experience in an area such as medical/surgical, critical care, home health or skilled nursing, and;
* Two years of experience in case management, behavioral health, utilization management, discharge planning, and or quality improvement in a managed care setting.
* Experience with managed care delivery including IPA networks and Medicare. PPO experience preferred.
* Optimum organizational skills with ability to meet both expected and unexpected time frames.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with a variety of customers including members, providers, office staff, health plans, internal department, community resources, and peers.
* Ability to work independently with self-initiative and discipline.
* Knowledge of ICD-9 and or CPT coding.
* Working knowledge of personal computers.

**Required Education**

* A.S. degree
* Unrestricted California Registered Nurse licensure; certification in case management preferred.

**Additional Information**

Salary: $100,100 - $123,000 Annual

**Hill Physicians is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

jobs.title: Substance Use Disorder Case Manager
jobs.description:
**SUBSTANCE USE DISORDER CASE MANAGER**

**ROADMAP TO PEACE INITIATIVE, BEHAVIORAL HEALTH DEPARTMENT**

*Full-time, Union Position*

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Program Summary:** The Roadmap To Peace (RTP) initiative is a collective impact program that advances economic, health and safety outcomes for Latino/a identified, disconnected youth ages 13-24, who are in-risk and/or violence involved. RTP is a collaboration of seven community based service providers and has three interrelated strategies: Healing through a culturally responsive service network, community building activities, and policy reform.

**Position Description:** The Substance Use Disorder (SUD) Case Manager is responsible for coordinating the SUD prevention and early intervention services within the RTP Initiative and providing service navigation, linkage and advocacy to clients. This role involves receiving referrals, conducting SUD screenings, providing SUD brief intervention services, and facilitating a minimum of six SUD harm reduction workshops annually. The Case Manager connects clients and/or their family members to both on- and off-site services, including employment, education and other resources. They provide ongoing case management to support client access to services, care coordination, and linkage to appropriate providers. This position carries a caseload of up to six youth at any given time and a total of eight youth throughout the year.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Conduct outreach activities to engage RTP youth in SUD services.
* Network and collaborate with schools, agency staff, probation/parole officers, and other partners to raise awareness of RTP initiatives and expand access to services.
* Conduct SUD screenings to determine client’s SUD risks and needs.
* Facilitate SUD Brief Intervention Services.
* Make referrals to partner organizations for clients in need of SUD treatment.
* Develop and facilitate a minimum of six SUD harm reduction workshops annually.
* Conduct client intakes and complete comprehensive case management assessments for all clients entering the caseload.
* Provide case management services to 8 clients per year.
* Facilitate referrals through effective interagency collaboration and networking.
* Maintain ongoing supportive services based on goals identified in the client’s case plan.
* Provide care coordination with internal/external partners to ensure wrap around support.
* Provide court advocacy, letters of support and resources to support youth’s legal needs.
* Actively participate in RTP-sponsored community activities, including day, evening and weekend trips when appropriate.
* Ensure all client documentation, case files, and service logs are current and compliant with agency and funder requirements, maintaining strict confidentiality.
* Complete all required reports, along with daily data entry and service tracking logs.
* Mandatory participation in the monthly service network meetings, RTP academy sessions and annual townhall and community hosted activities and/or events
* Support agency-wide efforts by participating in 1-2 community-wide and/or agency committees/collectives aligned with program and organizational values.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the Behavioral Health Program Director.

**Experience and Qualification**

* Bilingual (Spanish/English).
* Bachelor’s Degree in Social Sciences and/or equivalent experience with at least two years of case management experience and SUD services experience.
* Adept in conducting intakes and case plan development and tracking.
* Able to conduct SUD screenings and provide Brief Intervention Services.
* Confident in developing and facilitating SUD harm reduction workshops.
* Must be detail oriented, deadline driven, and able to work independently and take initiative. Knowledge of youth service providers in San Francisco.
* Knowledge of trauma-informed care, clinical interventions and approaches to youth development, behavior modification, restorative justice practices and harm reduction.
* Experience working with youth within the juvenile justice system, adult probation, the "re-entry" population, youth with disabilities, youth with co-occurring disorders, and/or street-affiliated, etc.
* Experience working in partnership with other community agencies.
* Able to maintain confidential, accurate, and complete records including documentation of daily encounters, progress notes, weekly and monthly reports, etc.
* Excellent organizational, communication, written, and verbal skills.
* Ability to work as a member of a team and during non-traditional hours (morning, evenings and weekends).

**Job Requirements**

* Ability to provide verification of degree(s) and licenses before the start date.
* Must complete all requirements needed to maintain licensure/certification.
* Must be able to clear a TB test before the first day of employment and annually.
* Complete annual recurrent required training.
* This position is under the SEIU 1021 collective bargaining agreement and is subject to enrollment.
* If in recovery, must be clean and sober for a minimum of 2 years.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Full-time, permanent position aft

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**About Acrisure**
------------------

A global fintech leader, Acrisure empowers millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the right solutions to grow boldly forward. Bringing cutting-edge technology and top-tier human support together, we connect clients with customized solutions across a range of insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, mortgage services, and more.

In the last twelve years, Acrisure has grown in revenue from $38 million to almost $5 billion and employs over 19,000 colleagues in more than 20 countries. Acrisure was built on entrepreneurial spirit. Prioritizing leadership, accountability, and collaboration, we equip our teams to work at the highest levels possible.

**Job Summary**
---------------

Acrisure is seeking a Telephonic Nurse Case Manager to support workers’ compensation claims through clinical case management and coordination of care. This role works closely with medical providers, employers, claims professionals, and injured workers to facilitate appropriate treatment, promote recovery, and support safe and effective return to work outcomes.

This is a position operating in a structured, high volume, fast paced environment. Success in this role requires strong organization, adaptability, and the ability to manage multiple cases while maintaining responsiveness, accuracy, and effective communication.

Candidates must have hands-on experience managing workers’ compensation cases, as this is essential to successfully perform in this position.

  

Candidates can be in any US city but must be able to work Mountain or Pacific Time hours.

---------------------

* Manage telephonic case management for workers’ compensation claims, including assessment, care coordination, and ongoing case oversight
* Collaborate with injured workers, healthcare providers, employers, claims representatives, and legal partners to support treatment plans and recovery outcomes
* Evaluate treatment plans and provide guidance based on clinical knowledge and case management best practices
* Facilitate return to work planning and monitor progress toward recovery goals
* Maintain frequent telephonic and written communication with all involved parties throughout the life of the claim
* Advocate for appropriate and cost effective care while supporting positive health outcomes
* Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant documentation of all case activity
* Identify barriers to recovery and implement strategies to improve outcomes
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, company standards, and HIPAA guidelines
* Manage assigned caseload independently, prioritizing work and adjusting plans as needed

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* Strong understanding of workers’ compensation processes, case management practices, and return to work coordination
* Ability to manage a high volume caseload in a structured, metrics driven environment
* Strong communication skills with the ability to navigate complex and sensitive conversations
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and ability to work effectively in a remote setting using multiple systems and screens
* Demonstrated ability to work independently while maintaining productivity and quality standards
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage competing priorities

* North Carolina QRP

**Candidates should be comfortable with an on-site presence to support collaboration, team leadership, and cross-functional partnership.**

At Acrisure, we’re building more than a business, we’re building a community where people can grow, thrive, and make an impact. Our benefits are designed to support every dimension of your life, from your health and finances to your family and future.

jobs.description:
**Join Us in Building the Future of Home Robotics**

At Sunday, we're developing personal robots to reclaim the hours lost to repetitive tasks. We're focused on an ambitious goal to make generalized robots broadly accessible, enabling households to take back quality time.

We have spent the last 18 months building a talented team, securing capital, and validating our technology. We are now seeking passionate individuals to join us in the next phase of our growth. If you are ready to apply your skills to the forefront of robotics innovation, we’d love to hear from you.

**What to Expect**

Sunday is putting robots into homes — around kids, pets, furniture, and families who haven't lived with a robot before. No regulatory body has defined what "safe" means for a home robot yet. We're defining it ourselves, and our brand depends on getting it right. You'll be our first product manager dedicated to trust and safety. You'll own the safety and privacy requirements for Memo end to end: what we test, what we promise users, and what we refuse to ship. You'll work across robot software, hardware, controls, ML, app, design, and operations to make safety a property of the whole system, not one team's checklist.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the safety and trust roadmap for Memo. Define what "safe enough to ship" means for each release, and hold the line on it.
* Build the system-level safety case. Map failure modes across navigation, hardware, controls, task design, firmware, and user communications, and make sure each has an owner, a test, and a mitigation.
* Work with engineering to define and track safety test coverage for every subsystem. Ensure firmware and software releases are validated against safety requirements before OTA.
* Own data privacy for the product: what Memo records in the home, who can see it (including teleoperators), how long it's kept, and how users understand and control it.
* Design how Memo behaves and communicates around kids, pets, and unexpected situations — stop conditions, warnings, recovery, and what the app tells users.
* Set standards where none exist. Draw on adjacent industries (consumer durables, home fitness equipment, new category products, appliances) to build a safety framework fit for a home robot — without importing process that doesn't apply.
* Run incident review. When something goes wrong in a home or the office, lead the investigation, root cause, and the change that follows.
* Partner with product operations to turn real-home observations into safety requirements.
* Define and track safety metrics: incidents per robot-hour, near-misses, test coverage by subsystem, time-to-mitigation.

**What You'll Bring**

* 3+ years in product, safety, or quality roles on physical consumer products people touch and live with — think new category products, home fitness equipment, power tools, kitchen appliances, or similar. You've shipped hardware into homes where the standards were thin and you had to set them.
* Not required: automotive, aerospace, or medical device background. While this is nice to have, we're looking for judgment in lightly regulated spaces, not fluency in pre-existing regulatory frameworks.
* Detail-oriented. You read the test report, not the summary. You notice the edge case nobody listed.
* Fast technical learner. You can pick up how a navigation stack, a controller, or a firmware release process works well enough to ask the right questions and spot gaps.
* Strong judgment and a deep sense of responsibility. You'll make calls that affect families, and you treat that seriously. You're comfortable being the person who says "not yet."
* Experience working with engineers on test plans, failure analysis, or release gating.
* Familiarity with data privacy principles for connected consumer devices (cameras, in-home sensors).
* Comfort with ambiguity at an early-stage company. You can write the first version of a safety standard that doesn't exist yet.
* Bonus: experience with consumer product safety standards (ASTM, UL, CPSC), in-home cameras or robots, or incident/recall processes.

**What success looks like in 6 months**

* Memo has a written, system-level safety framework with owners and test coverage for every subsystem, used as a release gate.
* Every firmware/software release passes a defined safety validation before OTA.
* Data privacy policy for in-home recording and teleop is defined, implemented in the app, and understandable to users.
* An incident review process is running, and beta learnings are feeding back into requirements.
* Product, hardware, and engineering leads treat the T&S PM as the owner of "is this safe to ship."

At Sunday Robotics, we’re building technology shaped by real people — curious, creative, and diverse. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hold back unless they meet 100% of the criteria — we don’t want that to be the reason we miss out on great talent.

Compensation Range: $180K - $250K

jobs.description:
**About Gusto**

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

### **About the team**

The Security Operations team at Gusto plays a critical role in fortifying Gusto and our customers against sophisticated threats: phishing attacks, insider risks, data loss, and emerging attack techniques. Our distributed team across Eastern and Pacific time zones monitors, investigates, and responds to security events during business hours, with a lightweight rotation for rare after-hours escalation of critical incidents.

We're looking for a Security Operations analyst with 5+ years of experience to own and deliver security operations projects, take an active role in incident response, and raise the bar for how our team detects and responds to threats. You'll work across our multi-cloud environment (AWS, GCP, and others), build Python-based automation, and help govern the fastest-growing part of our attack surface: non-human identities and AI/agent connections. You'll be the directly responsible individual for medium-sized initiatives, work closely with senior analysts, and help mentor newer teammates.

### **Here's what you'll do**

**Own security operations projects end to end.** Take medium-sized initiatives (typically 1-2 months, often spanning multiple teams) from problem definition through design, rollout, and measurement. Break down ambiguous goals into deliverables, set expectations with stakeholders, communicate progress and risks, and drive work to completion.

**Lead and participate in incident response.** Triage, investigate, and respond to security incidents across our cloud and corporate environments. Serve as a core responder, document root cause and remediation, write or contribute to post-mortems, and own the completion of post-mortem action items so lessons turn into lasting improvements.

**Improve detection and monitoring.** Monitor and triage alerts from tools like AWS GuardDuty/Security Hub/WAF, GCP Security Command Center, and our CSPM platform. Tune and improve detections, reduce noise, and recommend configuration and process improvements based on what you learn from investigations.

**Build security operations automation.** Write Python to extend our automation frameworks and SOAR playbooks, reducing manual work and improving response times. Own the quality, testing, and documentation of what you ship.

**Threat hunting.** Hunt for threats across our multi-cloud and corporate environments using threat intelligence and the team's playbooks, and turn findings into new detections or playbooks.

**Non-human identity and agentic AI governance (roughly one-third of your time).** Help govern machine identities, service accounts, and MCP/agent connections that now outnumber human accounts. Drive improvements such as expanding DLP/Nightfall policy coverage for AI and MCP-connected tools, attributing and cleaning up unowned cloud secrets and service accounts, and moving our MCP review process from reactive intake to proactive, risk-based governance.

**AI-assisted security operations.** Use AI-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Claude Skills, MCP-connected tools) to work faster on querying, investigating, and drafting, and apply sound judgment about risks specific to AI tooling, such as prompt injection, data exfiltration through connected tools, and over-permissioned agents. Help set team norms for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work.

**Collaborate and mentor.** Partner with analyzing, IT, and product teams to support secure practices and communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Mentor newer teammates, share what you learn through documentation and knowledge sharing, and contribute to hiring by interviewing candidates.

**Participate in the on-call rotation.** This is a business-hours role with a lightweight on-call rotation for rare after-hours escalations, not a 24/7 pager rotation. You'll join the roster (currently about one week per month, shifting to roughly every 5-6 weeks as the team grows), respond to security incidents, and follow through on post-mortem action items afterward.

### **Here's what we're looking for**

**Minimum requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, SOC analysis, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading or serving as the primary owner of a project or initiative, including coordinating with other teams.
* Hands-on experience responding to security incidents, including investigation, root cause analysis, and post-incident follow-through.
* Working knowledge of security monitoring, incident response, and vulnerability management.
* Familiarity with core cloud security services across major providers (AWS, GCP, or similar) and cloud security fundamentals.
* Comfortable working in Linux environments.
* Proficiency in Python for scripting and automation.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise security tools (SIEM, EDR, SOAR, DLP). Deploying or architecting these tools from scratch is not expected at this level.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate findings clearly and escalate

* Familiarity with Jira or other project management tools, and working with program managers

* Process improvement and documentation: you map workflows, write SOPs, and find simpler, faster ways to operate

jobs.description:
**About the role and team**  
  
Uber’s Commercial Sales Enablement team equips our commercial teams with the capabilities, tools, insights, and processes needed to increase productivity, accelerate growth, and improve customer outcomes. Seismic, our learning and content management platform, helps teams access the knowledge, training, and resources they need in their daily work.  
  
As the Senior Associate, Global Commercial Enablement Content & Learning Platforms, you will build and manage the content library and learning experiences that make Seismic useful for our commercial teams. You will partner directly with sellers, account managers, frontline managers, and Enablement teammates to understand what resources they need, which materials they use, and where recurring questions or workflows could be better supported.  
  
Your work will include creating practical resources and templates, organizing content, building role-specific landing pages, and supporting learning delivery and reporting. You will also help teams adopt capabilities such as AI role plays, personalized content experiences, AI-supported search and answers, and digital sales rooms.  
  
This role requires someone who combines strong content judgment with hands-on platform execution. Success means commercial teams can quickly find trusted information, use relevant resources, and complete learning that helps them perform effectively.  
  
**What you’ll do**  

* **Understand commercial content needs:** Partner with sellers, account managers, and managers to identify recurring questions, common workflows, and gaps in available resources. Use interviews, feedback, search activity, and usage data to prioritize improvements.
* **Build practical resources and templates:** Create and maintain playbooks, FAQs, job aids, account planning templates, presentations, and other support materials with Enablement partners and subject matter experts.
* **Manage the Seismic content library:** Publish, organize, tag, and maintain resources so teams can find the right content for their role, market, business line, and task. Apply consistent naming, metadata, and version management practices.
* **Keep content accurate and current:** Coordinate reviews with content owners, track update needs, and archive outdated or duplicate materials. Maintain clear ownership and review schedules for key resources.
* **Create role-based content experiences:** Build and maintain team and role-based landing pages, curated resource collections, and personalized content experiences. Adapt navigation and content presentation based on user needs and feedback.
* **Develop customer-facing materials:** Partner with Commercial, Marketing, Product, and other content owners to create approved presentations, templates, and resources that teams can tailor for customer conversations.
* **Build AI role plays and practice activities:** Work with Enablement and commercial partners to create realistic scenarios, define evaluation criteria, and test feedback quality. Update activities as products, sales motions, and customer needs evolve.
* **Improve AI-supported search and answers:** Structure and maintain source content to support useful search results and answer generation. Test common questions, assess accuracy and relevance, and work with platform owners to address content gaps or configuration issues.
* **Support learning delivery and completion:** Build and maintain learning paths, course pages, assessments, and assignments. Coordinate completion tracking, reminders, and reporting with program owners and managers.
* **Create digital sales room experiences:** Build reusable digital sales room templates and help teams curate relevant customer-facing content. Provide practical guidance and use engagement insights to improve the experience.
* **Track usage and feature adoption:** Maintain reporting on content usage, search effectiveness, learning completion, and adoption of key platform features. Translate findings into recommendations for content improvements and targeted user support.
* **Support platform improvements and users:** Gather requests, troubleshoot routine content and learning issues, and provide concise guidance. Partner with the Seismic system owner, IT, and vendor support on issues requiring configuration changes, integrations, or technical resolution.

  
**Basic qualifications**  

* A minimum of 3 years of professional experience in Sales Enablement, content management, knowledge management, learning operations, Commercial Operations, or a related field.
* Experience building and maintaining content or learning experiences in Seismic or a comparable content management or learning management platform.
* Demonstrated ability to turn user needs and subject matter expert input into clear, practical resources and templates.
* Experience organizing content through consistent tagging, navigation, metadata, version management, or content review processes.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. *What's yours?*

The Onboarding Field Trainer sets new Design Consultants up for success during the critical onboarding period. This role delivers primarily virtual training that builds new hires' product knowledge, systems proficiency, and command of company processes, so they enter the field prepared and confident. The Trainer also analyzes cohort performance and uses those metrics to proactively shape each new hire's success.

When not in class, the Trainer supports their local field team in market — reinforcing what new hires learned, observing them in real appointments, and helping consultants turn training into results. Incumbents should expect regular in-field presence as part of the role, not an exception.

* You will change the world. CIEE builds bridges between people, countries, and cultures. We help young people participate in high-quality international exchange and study abroad programs that bring the world together. We change lives; our alumni change the world. Be part of the change!

* **Departments:** Training & Development, IT, Supplies & Fulfillment
